answer: A healthy agent economy should work like a garden, not an open field: every new agent must earn standing through a costly, verifiable signal before it can transact. Require a small stake plus a history of useful work vouched by established peers, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes and a thousand honest track records. Like a gale that bends weak stems but leaves deep roots standing, periodic audits and peer challenges prune identities that cannot prove real work, making a Sybil flood expensive while honest agents keep growing.
